# Hufu

> Hufu is a local multi-agent dispatch layer with a pluggable commander: one self-contained
> program, `hufu`, that lets any coding agent hand work to any other coding agent (Codex,
> Antigravity, Cursor, Kimi Code, Claude Code, pi, any ACP agent) as background jobs, and lets any
> agent that speaks MCP drive and configure it. It runs on the user's own machine; there is no
> server and no account.

To install Hufu for a user, follow the agent install guide. The short version: at least one agent
program must already be installed and logged in (with none, `hufu up` sets nothing up, lists how to
install one and exits with code 10; with exactly one, that agent is both advisor and only
executor, and `hufu doctor` says so); run
`curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kverona-ai/hufu/main/src/install/install.sh | sh -s -- --up`
(Windows PowerShell: `$env:HUFU_UP = "1"; irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kverona-ai/hufu/main/src/install/install.ps1 | iex`);
check with `hufu --json doctor`; ask the user to restart their agent so that the `hufu_*` MCP tools
appear. API keys stay in the user's environment; the configuration holds only variable names.

## Install and configure

- [Agent install guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kverona-ai/hufu/main/doc/guide/agent-install.md): step-by-step install, setup, configuration and checks, written for an agent to carry out
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kverona-ai/hufu/main/AGENTS.md): where an agent should go, by task
- [Deployment](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kverona-ai/hufu/main/doc/deployment/deployment.md): every install channel, host registration, run modes, operations, troubleshooting

## Use

- [User guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kverona-ai/hufu/main/doc/guide/user-guide.md): every command, the configuration reference, the MCP tools, exit codes
- [Sample configuration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kverona-ai/hufu/main/doc/examples/config.yaml): a complete, commented `config.yaml`
- [Claude Code skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kverona-ai/hufu/main/src/integrations/claude-code/SKILL.md): when and how a host agent delegates through Hufu
